en: A black‑and‑white vintage postcard view of a small village with wooden houses beside a calm river or pond in which the buildings are reflected. On a slight hill behind the houses stands a white church with a tower and spire. Leafless trees and simple wooden fences surround the buildings, suggesting a rural Scandinavian setting. Printed text in Swedish appears at the top of the card.
